subject: Remit channel decision and VAT capture for multi-entity invoices
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <acme-ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Remit and VAT capture for upcoming contract — multi-entity

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the recent AMP review. Before legal signs off we need to confirm how Redwood will emit invoices for our multi-entity setup. Two asks from AP Legal:

1) Each invoice needs the VAT/Tax ID visible on the invoice line level (we have 3 legal entities).
2) AP prefers receiving invoices via automated email to acme-ap@acme-corp.com rather than requiring a portal login. If there's an API push or SFTP we can consume that too, but the visible copy must be a PDF emailed to the AP mailbox for their workflow.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) include VAT IDs per-entity on the PDF invoice, (b) send copies by email automatically, and (c) provide an SFTP or XML payload option if we move off email later?

Attached a sample of our invoice rules and VAT evidence.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Senior Director, Global Procurements
Acme Corp
Attachments: acme-vat-evidence.pdf (pdf), invoice-rules.csv (csv)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Remit and VAT capture for upcoming contract — multi-entity

Hi Laura — great summary. Short answers up front: yes on (a) and (b), and (c) we can provide XML/SFTP or a webhook/push. A few implementation notes:

- PDF invoice: our generation pipeline can add a VAT/Tax ID field at invoice-line or entity-level. We need a mapping file of which legal entity each charge should map to (attached CSV sample covers the required columns).
- Delivery: we typically recommend portal-first (for audit history and re-downloads) with an email fanout to AP so the email is the canonical incoming copy for your workflow. If you cannot use the portal at all, we can set up a direct automatic PDF email to acme-ap@acme-corp.com.
- Payloads: we support UBL/XML and a simple CSV invoice export over SFTP. We can also provide a webhook that posts a zipped XML+PDF bundle to a consumer endpoint.

Questions for you:
1) For the three entities, do you want separate invoices (one per legal entity) or a single consolidated invoice with line-level entity tags?
2) Who will be the AP approver email (confirm if acme-ap@acme-corp.com will accept attachments over 15MB if we push multiple PDFs)?

I'll loop Karthik for schema details and Connor for delivery setup. If we get a firm preference we can provide a short deployment runbook and test credentials.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: invoice-example-multientity.csv (csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Remit and VAT capture for upcoming contract — multi-entity

Laura / team — adding technical detail on the invoice schema and delivery options.

- Schema: We can emit a column on each invoice line called "legal_entity_tax_id" and a top-level field "invoice_legal_entity". The CSV sample attached to Mina shows the two options; UBL/XML will carry the same fields in the standard tax elements.
- Delivery options (support checklist):
  * Portal (recommended): audit trail + retry + long-term storage. We will still email a PDF copy to acme-ap@acme-corp.com if you want.
  * Email push: we can SMTP to your AP mailbox; we sign DKIM/SPF and send with unique message-id + invoice-id. We can throttle to avoid mailbox rate limits.
  * SFTP: nightly push of zipped XML+PDF bundles, file naming convention includes invoice date and invoice id.
  * Webhook: push to a mutually authenticated endpoint (mTLS or signed JWT).

Edge cases to flag: refunds/credit memos to the same legal entity, multi-entity charge splits (we always create a parent invoice with child invoice lines referencing entity tags when you request consolidated reporting).

Implementation ask from our side: a single CSV mapping file that lists: (party_name, legal_entity_id, tax_id, remit_address, preferred_delivery {email|portal|sftp|webhook}). If AP confirms "email" as preferred we will turn on automatic copies and include invoice_legal_entity and legal_entity_tax_id on the PDF.

I'll prepare the sample UBL schema and an SFTP folder layout later today.

—Karthik
Billing Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <acme-ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Remit and VAT capture for upcoming contract — multi-entity

Thanks Mina and Karthik — this is helpful. AP confirmed the following today:

1) They want separate invoices per legal entity (acme-us, acme-eu, acme-uk) rather than a consolidated invoice.
2) Delivery: primary delivery MUST be an emailed PDF to acme-ap@acme-corp.com. Portal access is optional for us but we will accept a portal copy too.
3) SFTP is a nice-to-have for phase 2; we want the email path in place for go-live.

I'll prepare the mapping CSV and send it by end of day (contains tax ids and remit addresses). For now please enable the automatic email copy and confirm message-id pattern so our mail team can whitelist it.

Also: can you confirm whether the PDFs will include the VAT number on both the header and each relevant line item? AP expects the VAT on the header for reconciliation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Laura
Senior Director, Global Procurements, Acme Corp
